title: Gaussian concentration, integral probability metrics, and coupling functionals for infinite lattice systems
summary: We develop a transport-entropy framework for Gaussian concentration inequalities on the infinite product space $S^{\mathbb Z^d}$, where $S$ is a finite set, in which sensitivity is measured by the $\ell^2$-norm of local oscillations. We show that the associated transportation costs cannot be induced by any metric or cost function on the configuration space, due to a structural lack of extensivity in infinite product spaces.
